effect.name: Grayscale
effect.description: Drains the colour out of a sprite or a whole layer. Four weightings, because "grey" is not one thing: Rec.601 luminance is what your eye reads, plain average is what most pixel art was drawn against.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: 0 is the original, 1 is fully grey.

parameter.name: Mode
parameter.description: 0 luminance (Rec.601), 1 flat average, 2 lightness (max and min averaged), 3 brightest channel.
